skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic knowledge, classify types of MICE events and factors affecting the MICE service market.
Understand the functions of hotel departments related to event organization, operation, and management.
Understand the event organization process and coordination between relevant departments.
Understand general management knowledge and MICE management.
Analyze economic indicators, financial performance, and business efficiency of event organizing services.
Complete requirements for operational skills in hotel event organization such as reception, food service, planning, and coordination with relevant departments.
Have skills in coordinating and allocating necessary resources to complete assigned tasks.
Propose ideas for various types of events and present and explain these ideas.
